content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered: synth-check 'eu-synth-roundtrip-01' failing threshold (error_rate > 35%)
Probe group: synthetic-canaries-eu
Recent failures: 18/30 in last 5m
Alert links: <http://ops.redwood/synth/alerts/2765432199>
Logs:
```
PROBER ERROR: tls handshake failed: EOF
remote_ip=35.198.12.4
probe_id=eu-rt-01
x509_error=x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
```
Auto-created PD incident: PD123456 -> paging oncall-junior

oncall-junior: Acked PD123456. I'm looking — starting with prober logs and recent deploy diffs.

pagerduty: PD Alert: page fired for PD123456; escalation to oncall-senior in 5m unless acknowledged.

ben: Any customer impact? I checked grafana (api-public / lat/5m) and don't see 5xx spikes.

dina: Dashboards only show synth failures and a small latency bump for synthetic probes. Prober logs show TLS handshake + x509 errors from the collector pool. Might be cert or collector egress issue.

charlie: Rolling health for inference hosts in eu-west-1: hosts responding, 8/8 healthy per instance-health. I'll run curl to be sure.

charlie: ```
curl -v https://inference-eu-01.redwood.prod/health
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"ok"}
```

charlie: Hosts look fine. traceroute from prober -> shows drop at our edge LB. Could be firewall or broken cert handshake from prober side.

alice: I'm taking this incident. @oncall-junior please hand off context, and mute noisy alerts to avoid flooding. Did PD get escalated?

oncall-junior: Handoff: acked PD at 2765432205, collected logs, muted synth-eu alerts for 10m to prevent flapping. Quick checks I ran:
```
sudo iptables -L | grep 35.198.12.4  # no explicit block found
# tls verify from prober box:
openssl s_client -connect inference-eu-01.redwood.prod:443 -showcerts
# shows cert chain with 'notAfter' in the past for the prober client cert
```
Also captured prober logs showing repeated: "x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid" timestamp 16:12:03 UTC.

dina: If the prober's client cert expired, rotate it and redeploy the prober collector. I can handle cert rotation with KMS. Ops-bot, can you queue a redeploy?

ops-bot: Received request to queue deploy job. Creating job deploy-778 for prober-collector-eu.

incident-bot: PD123456 acknowledged by alice. Escalation paused.

ben: Confirming customer impact: no visible user-facing errors. Synthetic-only failures so far. I'll open a follow-up ticket for RCA and runbook items.

alice: Action items (summary):
- dina: verify and rotate prober client cert; redeploy collector.
- oncall-junior: keep synth-eu alerts muted until redeploy verifies stability.
- ben: create incident follow-up ticket and draft postmortem.
- alice: adjust synth threshold temporarily to reduce noise and schedule PIR.
I'll take ownership for the post-incident review. :thumbsup:

dina: Starting cert rotation: requesting new client cert from KMS, building new prober image with cert pinned to /etc/prober/client.pem, pushing image tag prober-collector-eu:rot-2026-03-14.

ops-bot: deploy-778 started -> pulling prober image -> applying config -> rolling restart prober-collector-eu -> status: success (2765432387).

dina: Redeploy complete. Observability: failures dropped from 18/30 -> 1/30 in the following 10m window. Re-enabling alerts in 5m to watch for regressions.

incident-bot: PD123456 auto-resolved by monitoring (no new alerts after redeploy).

alice: Thank you team. I'll mark this as mitigated and schedule a blameless postmortem. No customer-facing outage found, impact confined to synthetic probes. Follow-up ticket: RED-INC-2026-045 (ben). Closing handoff to oncall-senior.

ben: Opening ticket now, will include logs, deploy IDs, and proposed runbook update: add prober cert rotation steps + automated monitoring of prober cert expiry.

oncall-junior: Leaving notes in PD: muted for 10m, redeploy job id deploy-778, observed prober x509 expiry.

alice: Great. Closing thread — please +1 the follow-up ticket when it's ready. :white_check_mark:
